description: Variation of Conditions 7(cc) (Submission of details), 7(m) (Submission of details), 16 (Installation of jib door (upper ground floor)), 20 (Reinstatement of existing architrave) and 21 (Reinstatement of existing architrave) of listed building consent LB/23/05694 (Modifications to external fa‡ades of built elements, including resolution of level 03 roof terrace above 1950s extension; secondary glazing proposals and associated fabric upgrade; internal alterations to general arrangement layouts; proposed demolition and replacement of the non-original ceilings; changes to third floor lead roof) to provide detailed methodology of the proposed removal and reinstatement of the door lining and architrave, submission of detailed elevation drawings, installation of a jib door prior to the occupation of the building and reinstatement of the existing historic architrave.
